

# nettest.exe is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/nettest-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(nettest_shims OBJECT nettest.c)
target_link_libraries(nettest_shims PRIVATE libws2_32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(nettest nettest-cargo nettest.exe
    KIND win32exe
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS nettest_shims)
